sentences.text: Approach the person slowly, ideally heading into the wind or sea so you can stop alongside under control.
Shift to neutral well before you reach them, and keep the propeller away.
Bring them aboard over the side, not at the stern near the propeller, using a boarding ladder, a sling, or a parbuckle made from a line or net.
A tired or cold person can’t climb, so plan to lift them.
Once aboard, treat for hypothermia and shock, and get medical help.
